title: Test standards for joist hangers.
officialText:
The vertical load-bearing capacity, torsional moment capacity and deflection
characteristics of joist hangers shall be determined in accordance with ASTM D 1761, using lumber having a specific gravity of
0.49 or greater, but not greater than 0.55, as determined in accordance with AF&PA NDS for the joist and headers.
Exception: The joist length shall not be required to exceed 24 inches (610 mm).
